gloss: to trouble; to torment; to vex

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {悩|なや}ませていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to trouble; to worry; to torment; to vex
definitions.explanation: To cause someone to suffer worry, distress, or difficulty. The causative form of {悩|なや}む (to worry), used when an external factor or person causes the trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悩|なや}ませて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{腰痛|ようつう}→腰痛：05020_youtsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{悩|なや}ませてきた。
examples.english: Back pain has plagued him for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{難問|なんもん}→難問：18031_nanmon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悩|なや}ませてきた⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: This difficult problem is an issue that has vexed many researchers.

notes:
The causative form of ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to worry, to be troubled). While grammatically a causative, {悩|なや}ませる has become a standard transitive verb in its own right and is commonly used with inanimate subjects (problems, pain, weather, etc.) that cause trouble.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧（⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧）⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悩|なや}ませる — something troubles someone
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悩|なや}ませられる — to be troubled by (passive of causative)
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{悩|なや}ませてきた — has troubled for many years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{困|こま}らせる→困る：00861_komaru⟧ — to cause difficulty for someone (more practical/concrete problems)
- ⟦{苦|くる}しめる→苦しめる：01939_kurushimeru⟧ — to cause suffering, to torment (stronger, more painful)
- ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ — to worry, to be troubled (intransitive base verb)
